title: List of Yellowstone characters
premise_summary: Yellowstone is an American neo-Western drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan and John Linson. It premiered June 20, 2018 on Paramount Network and ended on December 15, 2024. The series follows many conflicts over borders and control of the Yellowstone Ranch, a huge cattle ranch; it is surrounded by the Broken Rock Indian reservation, Yellowstone National Park, and rival land developers.
